newsitem.title: USA: Comstock development wells raise production.
newsitem.headline: Comstock development wells raise production.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said Tuesday an infill development well drilled in the Double A Wells field in Polk County, Texas, is producing 10.2 million cubic feet of natural gas and 768 barrels of condensate per day on a 28/64 inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 2,600 pounds per square inch.

Comstock said it owns a 32 percent working interest in the Carter-Battise No. 3 well, which was drilled to a depth of 14,217 feet and completed in the upper Woodbine formation through perforations at 13,969 feet to 14,021 feet.

Comstock said it also has completed the Champion 1Y in the Double A Wells field. The well was drilled to a total depth of 3,830 feet and completed in the Yegua formation through perforations at 3,609 feet to 3,615 feet. After perforating, the well is currently producing 1.0 million cubic feet of natural gas daily on a 12/64 inch choke with initial flowing pressure of 1,260 pounds per square inch. Comstock owns a 27 percent working interest in the well.
Currently, Comstock is drilling the West Bay Carter 1, a 14,400 foot wildcat Woodbine prospect on the Pate prospect acreage located to the west of the Double A Wells field.
